comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus transport a threaded collar along a curved protected guide.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses tool engagement and countertorque; the collar task requires occlusion-aware constrained transport while maintaining hidden clearance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angle and cycles; the collar task requires threading preserved, no prohibited contact, target support and alignment, release, and stillness.
comparison.reason: The complete body lacks a task.json rubric but clearly tests protected-guide transport under changing occlusion, not adjustment locking.
